2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Taljhari PS Case No.69 of 2023,
for offence registered under section 406, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 34 of the IPC, pending in court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Rajmahal.

3.
